name: ue-repo-reader
description: Read Unreal Engine projects from a git URL: Blueprints, maps and data assets decoded from binary .uasset/.umap files, no editor needed.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze Unreal projects, Blueprints included, from a git URL
interface.longDescription: Give it an Unreal Engine git repository URL. It decodes Blueprints (graphs as pseudo-code), Level Blueprints and placed actors, DataTables, structs, enums, Behavior Trees, input mappings and DataAssets straight from the binary assets, indexes the C++, and lets ChatGPT review or explain the whole project.
defaultPrompt: Review the Blueprints in this repo for performance problems
Explain how input flows from the player controller to gameplay in this project
